derivedFrom: marketing/03-visual-identity/DA.md (R-CITE: palette hex, typography, motion, composition all grounded in DA.md §Color palette / §Typography / §Motion language / §Composition)
concept: The programmable terminal made visible, a dark, monospaced, grid-first system that looks like the tool it sells

roles.note: 60/30/10 per spec §2.1.5, dominant terminal-black canvas / secondary pane-chrome / one mint accent. WCAG AA 4.5:1 for text. R-CITE: DA.md §Color palette.
roles.dominant60: bg (#0B0E14) + bg2 (#11161F), the near-black terminal canvas
roles.secondary30: surface (#1E2733) + surface2 (#1A2030), pane chrome, grid dividers, code block borders
roles.accent10: accent #36E2C4 ('rmux mint') for one focal element per frame: logo mark, blinking cursor, active pane, CTA button. amber #F0883E ONLY as a functional 'agent running / alert' status glyph, never as a second brand color, never in the same frame as a loud accent.

display.note: Marketing headlines, carousel covers. Real jump from body. R-CITE: DA.md §Typography 'Headings: neo-grotesk, Geist/Inter, medium/semibold, tight leading'.

mono.note: Wordmark, all terminal output, code blocks, shell commands. The identity typeface. R-CITE: DA.md §Typography 'Display/wordmark: Berkeley Mono / Geist Mono / JetBrains Mono, lowercase rmux, tight tracking'.

body.note: Body copy on marketing surfaces. Fallback for display on smaller targets.

eyebrow.usage: RARE, platform label (X / LinkedIn), pillar tag (Agentic Terminal / SDK), never decorative wallpaper

numeric.usage: all stats, versions (v0.3.1), line counts (~514 LOC), benchmark ms, command counts (90 commands)

type.scaleRatio: 80px:32px (2.5x jump display→body per spec §2.1.4, a real jump not a 1.2x step)
type.note: 2 families max: Geist (display/body marketing) + Geist Mono / JetBrains Mono (wordmark + all terminal copy). No decorative fonts, DA.md DON'T.

enter.note: Fast ease-out snap, the feel of a terminal command landing. R-CITE: DA.md §Motion 'fast, eased snap (~150-200ms)'.

splitReveal.note: A pane divides / new pane slides in. The multiplex-grid motion signature. R-CITE: DA.md §Motion 'panes split with a fast, eased snap'.

emphasis.note: Key data reveals, snapshot payload appearing, benchmark popping in.

cursorBlink.note: The mint #36E2C4 cursor blinks at real terminal cadence, the only looping signature motion. R-CITE: DA.md §Motion 'cursor blinks at a real terminal cadence'.

logoIntro.note: Wordmark 'rmux' types in one character at a time at ~60ms/char, then cursor blinks once. Mechanical, purposeful, never bounce.

motion.reducedMotion: cursor static (no blink), pane splits appear instantly, reveals immediate, hierarchy preserved
motion.principle: Motion is mechanical and purposeful, never decorative. R-CITE: DA.md §Motion 'purposeful, never decorative (matches the operator's motion taste)'.

canvas.deriveBy: recomposition, never cropping (spec §2.1.1), 16:9 for OG cards / YouTube thumbnails / screencap demos

grid.note: Left-aligned by default, terminal output anchors to the left ($ / ❯ prompt). Pane-grid dividers at #1E2733.

meta.note: unified Stories/Reels March 2026, critical elements out of top 270px / bottom 670px Reels

photo.light: single matte directional key, dark studio, no spill, one motivated source only. R-CITE: DA.md §Photography '3D/render: matte, low-noise, dark studio, single mint rim-light on geometric pane blocks'.
photo.grain: near-zero grain on UI / screencaps (must stay crisp); faint Kodak Gold 200 grain ONLY on any physical environment (desk, hardware) if a lensed shot is used
photo.materials: dark anodized aluminum, matte black keycap surface, high-DPI terminal screen glowing, thin cable
photo.surfaces: near-black #0B0E14 field; crisp real rmux terminal screencaps on #11161F / #1E2733 pane chrome; NO blur, NO glassmorphism
photo.seriesLock: one focal length + one light recipe + this palette + this grain repeated VERBATIM across every asset of a series (spec §2.2 series discipline)
photo.subjectDoctrine: product/scene-led, NO stock people, NO hands-on-keyboard clichés, NO recurring human avatar (avatar-soul.md). Recurring identity anchor = the multiplex pane grid + the mint #36E2C4 cursor + the rmux wordmark. R-CITE: DA.md §Photography 'No stock photography. No human-hand-on-keyboard clichés.'
photo.firstClassAssets: real high-DPI screencaps of shipped demos (orchestration, broadcast, mirroring, Playwright testing) beat synthetic generation, credible to the ICP and fully on-DA. R-CITE: shotlist.md Production notes.
forbidden: amber as a second identity color

logo.wordmark: lowercase 'rmux' in Geist Mono (or JetBrains Mono), tight tracking, #E6EDF3 on #0B0E14
logo.iconVariant: monospaced 'r>' glyph (prompt symbol) OR a 2x2 pane-grid icon in accent #36E2C4, for avatar/profile use
logo.clearSpaceX: one X-height of the wordmark on all sides
logo.watermark: 'rmux' in #E6EDF3 or #36E2C4, corner, small, no background fill
logo.note: R-CITE: DA.md §Typography 'The wordmark is monospaced on purpose, it IS a terminal tool.'

avatar.decision: scene-led / product-led, no recurring human avatar (marketing/03-visual-identity/higgsfield/avatar-soul.md). Identity is the terminal itself: canvas #0B0E14, mint cursor #36E2C4, the split-pane grid, the lowercase monospaced rmux wordmark. Generate WITHOUT --soul-id.
avatar.note: see avatar-persona.md for the scene-led environment brief + five recurring settings
